answer: The echo register is checked at draw time, saffron lists the eligible set, and garden seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 69 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 69 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker burns for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 11 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
